rows.en:
It's just, I can't decide what to get
for a Christmas present.
rows.notes: Female version; same English as c00423.

rows.en: Oh my, is it for your boyfriend?

Sadly, no.
It's for the Christmas party.
(He went on and on for almost an hour...)
rows.notes: Female version; subject is Bobby (male per glossary).

rows.en:
(I'm kinda hungry... Maybe I'll grab
something to eat on the way home.)

rows.notes: x4. The player says Ozma-san (san, not a rank).

rows.en: What are you doing around here?

I'm hungry, so I thought I'd get
something to eat.

You... You're not planning on going
to Nyan-Nyan, are you?
rows.notes: Male version; Ozma is protective of Ranka, who works there.

rows.en: N-no... I haven't decided where to go yet.
...If you're going, you're taking me with you...
What's the point of bullying a kid, Ozma?

My, what a charming greeting, Ozma.
Keep being so cranky and girls will hate you.

What a nice answer! You're just bursting
with youth~!

So you're going out to eat?
Mind if I tag along?

Why should I have to eat with you?
I'm eating one-on-one with this kid.
rows.notes: koitsu = the player; 'this kid' keeps it gender-neutral (shared row).

rows.en:
Oh, come on.
Food tastes better with lots of people, you know?

(I never said a single word about eating
with them...)

rows.notes: x4: a choice here, but also a spoken line by Pinon in ext_pnn_002 ('kaeru' = I'm going home). 'Going home' reads as both.

rows.en: I knew it! You WERE planning on Nyan-Nyan!
Oh, who cares? Let's go see Ranka-chan.
How did I end up paying for this...
rows.notes: Shared by the Nyan-Nyan and oden branches.

rows.en:
You were yelling way too much in there.
Be grateful you didn't get banned.
rows.notes: Shared by both branches; 'in there' keeps it generic.

rows.en: Say my name first! You idiot!
...You're not just forcing yourself, are you?
rows.notes: Ozma suspects the player picked oden out of fear of him.

rows.en: (I've gotta stay away from those two...)
You planning on going to Nyan-Nyan?

Hey, Alto.
Let's go to S.M.S.
rows.notes: x5; also tagged Michel/female in the script dump, but the text is the male player's.
x23 soudana: generic agreement used by many speakers.

rows.en: I wonder what we're doing in training today...
Who knows... Depends on the Captain's mood.
rows.notes: taichou = Ozma; rendered 'the Major' per the brief (Ozma-taichou -> Major). Aligned to the glossary decision of 2026-10-17.

rows.en: Oh my, if it isn't a whole lineup of hunks...!

Hello. Are you headed to S.M.S. too,
Bobby-san?
Yes, to do some tuning on the Quarter.

Sounds like hard work.
With a ship that size, there must be a ton
of things to check.
Well, it's my job, so it can't be helped.

Now then, let's all four go together,
nice and friendly!

H-hey! Don't pull me!
And quit linking arms with me!!
Ahh, it's so nice to be young...

Oh, I know!
How about some tea after training?

Oh my, here I am offering to treat you to tea,
and Princess Alto isn't satisfied?
rows.notes: Alto-hime = Princess Alto (teasing nickname, glossary alias).

uncertain: c00474: shared by a menu choice and a spoken Pinon line; 'Going home' chosen to serve both.
c00501: script dump also lists this row under Michel and the female scene; translated as the male player's line it reads as.
